additionalSubgroups.semantics: Literal paid No remains No despite broad completion yes. Paid, partly paid, and waived-but-not-paid examples do not establish any waiver, restitution satisfaction, or entitlement. Juvenile node is routing-only under the existing adult-package scope.
additionalSubgroups.predecessorBehavior: The predecessor adult automatic acquittal candidate held solely on an unknown financial answer; the retained source contract has no financial predicate. That prior behavior is a defect, not accepted legal behavior.
additionalSubgroups.boundedCorrection: For the exact adult automatic nonconviction candidate with a known adult age and canonical acquittal, financial uncertainty is not a routing or collection predicate. Other outcomes, unknown ages, juvenile and sibling routes are unchanged; raw financial history survives.
